reason: The plugin is primarily a monitoring utility that retrieves DeepSeek account balance data and displays account balance plus derived per-session spend in the DSH Web composer.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 编辑器中读取并显示 DeepSeek 账户余额及按会话估算的消费金额。
summaries.en: Displays the DeepSeek account balance and an estimated per-session spend in the DSH Web composer.

capabilities: Reads a configured DeepSeek API credential reference through the host credential service
Fetches account balance data from the DeepSeek balance endpoint
Provides a loopback-only host route for balance retrieval
Caches balance results for a configured interval
Stores per-session starting balances in browser localStorage
Displays account balance and derived session spend in the composer UI
